name: io.github.darylmcd/roslyn-mcp
description: Local-first MCP server for semantic C# analysis & refactoring via Roslyn & MSBuildWorkspace.

environmentVariables.name: ROSLYNMCP_SANCTIONED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Server-owned filesystem boundary for path validation and solution discovery. Path-separator-delimited (';' on Windows, ':' on macOS/Linux). '.' scopes the server to its working directory. An empty value fails closed: every path-taking tool rejects its input.
